notes: Account overview: Elysian Compliance Solutions is a RegTech vendor providing LLM-driven compliance assistants and monitoring for retail and corporate banks. They are exploring Redwood Private (VPC) for full data custody and stronger cryptographic controls.

Primary security ask: BYOK-first model. CISO (Daniel Alvarez) emphasized: 'We must retain key ownership — provider must never have root access to customer keys.' HSM-backed keys required for certain customers.

KMS/HSM requirements: support AWS KMS (CMKs, cross-account grants), Azure Key Vault (HSM-backed keys), GCP KMS, and BYOK import flows. Prefer envelope encryption with customer-managed master keys and CloudHSM / Thales HSM integration for high-assurance keys.
Compliance constraints: SOC2 + ISO27001 baseline, FIPS 140-2 validated crypto modules for HSM; contractual language requested for key separation, key rotation SLAs, and right-to-audit.

Audit & telemetry: all key usage and KMS admin ops must be captured in tamper-evident audit logs, forwarded to Splunk and retained for 7 years for regulated product lines. Prefer signed audit bundles and indexing for e-discovery.
Network & deployment: VPC peering with transit gateway, private endpoints only, strict egress ACLs. Option for on-prem HSM bridging via site-to-site VPN for largest bank customers.
Performance targets: embedding throughput ~200 req/s; chat p95 token latency <50ms. Lead infra engineer expects envelope encryption overhead to be <5ms per request; need measurements during POC.

POC plan: start with embeddings workload using AWS KMS CMKs + envelope encryption, validate rotation and key policy constraints, demonstrate audit log ingestion to Splunk, then expand to Azure/GCP and HSM-backed keys.
Commercial notes: willing to accept premium pricing for Private+HSM but need clear ARR modeling. Procurement flagged long lead time for HSM procurement — may require staged rollout.
Quotes: Legal: 'No provider-stored root keys; explicit BYOK clauses + audit rights.' CISO: 'Any sign of key exfiltration risks is a non-starter.'
Next POC milestone: KMS integration design doc due 2025-03-05; architecture deep-dive with infra + security team 2025-03-10. Target pilot completion Q2 2025.
